description: 用英语说清倦怠、边界和求助需求，不把「我没事」当成唯一答案。

targetChunks.en: I've been feeling really burnt out.
targetChunks.note: burnt out = 长期压力导致的耗竭；比 tired 严重。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I've been feeling really burnt out lately.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我最近一直觉得很倦怠。

targetChunks.en: I think I need to talk to someone.
targetChunks.note: someone 可指朋友/咨询师；不把话说死，降低开口难度。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I think I need to talk to someone.

targetChunks.en: I've been having trouble switching off.
targetChunks.zh: 我一直很难真正停下来。
targetChunks.note: switch off = 放松、停止想工作；比 relax 更具体。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I've been having trouble switching off after work.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 下班后我一直很难真正停下来。

targetChunks.en: It's been going on for a few months.
targetChunks.note: 说清持续时间，帮助对方理解严重程度。
targetChunks.exampleEn: It's been going on for a few months now.

targetChunks.en: I don't want to burden you with this.
targetChunks.note: burden = 负担；开口求助时的常见顾虑。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I don't want to burden you with this.

targetChunks.note: 别人关心时，比 I'm fine 更真实的回应。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I appreciate you asking — not many people do.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 谢谢你问起，很少有人会问。

targetChunks.en: I need to set some boundaries.
targetChunks.note: boundary = 边界；工作/关系里保护自己。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I need to set some boundaries around my time.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我需要在时间上设些边界。

targetChunks.en: I'm not looking for advice — just someone to listen.
targetChunks.zh: 我不是要建议，只想有人听。
targetChunks.note: 明确需求，避免对方急着给方案。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'm not looking for advice — just someone to listen.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我不是要建议，只想有人听。

targetChunks.en: It helps to say it out loud.
targetChunks.note: say it out loud = 把话说出口；表达倾诉的价值。
targetChunks.exampleEn: It helps to say it out loud.

targetChunks.en: I'm thinking about seeing a therapist.
targetChunks.zh: 我在考虑看心理咨询师。
targetChunks.note: therapist / counselor；主动求助不是软弱。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'm thinking about seeing a therapist.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我在考虑看心理咨询师。

targetChunks.note: check in on someone = 关心近况；收尾温暖。

roleplay.promptZh: 你最近长期加班、睡眠很差。朋友问你怎么样，你决定不再说「没事」，而是说清状态、需求和边界。
roleplay.promptEn: You've been overworked and sleeping badly. A friend asks how you are. Instead of saying 'fine,' explain what's going on, what you need, and where your boundaries are.
goals: 用具体状态代替 I'm fine
明确需要倾听而不是建议

script.speaker: other
script.en: Hey, how have you been? You seem a bit off.
script.zh: 嘿，你最近怎么样？看起来有点不对劲。

script.speaker: you
script.en: I appreciate you asking. To be honest, I've been feeling really burnt out.
script.zh: 谢谢你问起。说实话，我一直觉得很倦怠。

script.speaker: you
script.en: It's been going on for a few months. I've been having trouble switching off.
script.zh: 已经持续几个月了。我一直很难真正停下来。

script.speaker: other
script.en: Have you tried just taking a break?
script.zh: 你试过干脆休息一下吗？

script.speaker: you
script.en: I'm not looking for advice — just someone to listen. It helps to say it out loud.
script.zh: 我不是要建议，只想有人听。说出来好受些。

script.speaker: you
script.en: Thanks. I need to set some boundaries, and I'm thinking about seeing a therapist.
script.zh: 谢谢。我需要设些边界，也在考虑看心理咨询师。

script.speaker: other
script.en: That sounds like a good step.
script.zh: 这听起来是很好的一步。
